name: ns-trains
title: NS Trains
description: Next NS trains between two stations (default Tilburg → Eindhoven Centraal), with delays, platforms, crowding and disruptions.
author: marijn_panhuijsen

commands.name: next-trains
commands.title: Next Trains
commands.subtitle: NS
commands.description: Show the upcoming trips on your route. ⌘S swaps the direction, ⌘⇧F / ⌘⇧T pick another departure or destination station.

commands.name: next-train-menu-bar
commands.title: Next Train in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: NS
commands.description: Show the next departure (with delay and platform) on the route chosen in Next Trains.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: NS API Key
preferences.description: Primary key of your Ns-App subscription on apiportal.ns.nl.

preferences.name: fromStation
preferences.title: From Station
preferences.description: NS station code, e.g. TB (Tilburg). Default route; Next Trains can switch to another one.

preferences.name: toStation
preferences.title: To Station
preferences.description: NS station code, e.g. EHV (Eindhoven Centraal). Default route; Next Trains can switch to another one.
